CVE-2009-2473.title: neon before 0.28.6, when expat is used, does not properly detect  ...
CVE-2009-2473.description: neon before 0.28.6, when expat is used, does not properly detect recursion during entity expansion, which allows context-dependent attackers to cause a denial of service (memory and CPU consumption) via a crafted XML document containing a large number of nested entity references, a similar issue to CVE-2003-1564.
